3º de Primaria · Inglés · Tema 8

Sports and hobbies

Nombre: ______________________   Fecha: ___________

Qué vas a aprender

  • Name sports and free-time activities
  • Use play, go and do correctly with sports
  • Talk about the days you do your hobbies: on Mondays, at the weekend
  • Ask and answer «What do you do in your free time?»

Para pensar

En español decimos «jugar al fútbol», «ir a nadar» y «hacer kárate». ¿En inglés se usa siempre el mismo verbo?

Explicación

Sports

Sports are great for our body and to make friends. Here are some: football (fútbol), basketball (baloncesto), tennis, volleyball, handball (balonmano), swimming (natación), cycling (ciclismo), skating (patinaje), gymnastics (gimnasia) and karate.

Some sports are played in a team (equipo): football, basketball, volleyball. Others are individual: swimming, tennis, gymnastics. En castellano: muchos nombres de deportes vienen del inglés: foot (pie) + ball (pelota) = fútbol.

Play, go or do?

The verb depends on the sport. Play + sports with a ball or games: play football, play tennis, play basketball, play chess. Go + sports ending in -ing: go swimming, go cycling, go skating, go running. Do + martial arts and other activities: do karate, do judo, do gymnastics, do yoga.

Truco: si hay pelota, play; si acaba en -ing, go; y para lo demás, do. Nunca se dice «play swimming» ni «do football».

Hobbies and free time

A hobby is something you do in your free time (tiempo libre) because you enjoy it. Popular hobbies: reading books, drawing and painting, playing the guitar or the piano, dancing, singing, playing video games, cooking, collecting stickers or stones and taking photos.

To talk about hobbies we often use like + -ing: «I like reading comics», «My sister loves dancing». ¿Cuál es tu hobby favorito?

Days of the week

To say when you do your hobbies, you need the days of the week: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday. Saturday and Sunday are the weekend.

We use on with days: «I play basketball on Mondays and on Wednesdays.» And at with the weekend: «I go cycling at the weekend.» Ojo: en inglés los días se escriben siempre con mayúscula: Monday, no monday.

What do you do in your free time?

To ask about hobbies, say: What do you do in your free time? Answer with I + activity: «I play the piano and I go swimming.» To ask about a sport: «Do you play tennis?» — «Yes, I do.» / «No, I don't.»

To ask about days: «When do you do karate?» — «On Tuesdays and Thursdays.» En castellano: en español ponemos «los martes»; en inglés es on + día con -s: «on Tuesdays».

Sports places and things

Each sport has got its place and its equipment (material). We play football on a pitch (campo), tennis on a court (pista) and we swim in a swimming pool (piscina). We go skating in an ice rink (pista de hielo) and do gymnastics in a gym.

Equipment: a ball, a racket (raqueta), a bike, a helmet (casco), trainers (zapatillas de deporte), goggles (gafas de natación) and a net (red). «For tennis you need a racket and a ball.»

Teamwork and fair play

When we do sport we must respect the rules and the other players. That is fair play (juego limpio). Useful phrases: Well done! (¡bien hecho!), Good game! (¡buen partido!), Pass the ball! (¡pasa la pelota!), My turn! (¡me toca!), Your turn! and Let's play together!

Win or lose, shake hands at the end and say «Good game!». A good player helps the team: We win together, we lose together. Ganar es bonito, pero divertirse y respetar es lo más importante.

Reading: Jake's week

Read Jake's timetable of activities: «I love sport! On Mondays I play basketball with my school team. On Wednesdays I go swimming at the sports centre. On Fridays I do judo. At the weekend I go cycling with my mum. I don't play football, but I watch it on TV with my grandpa. I've also got a quiet hobby: I collect stamps from other countries!»

Answer: When does Jake go swimming? Does he play football? What does he collect?

Let's practise: a class survey

Make a survey. Write five activities in a table: play football, go swimming, do karate, play the piano, read comics. Ask ten classmates: «Do you play football?» «Do you go swimming?» Tick the answers.

Then make a bar chart and say the results: «Seven children play football. Three children do karate. Nobody plays the piano!» ¿Cuál es la actividad más popular de tu clase?

Sports and hobbies

Ejercicios

  1. Traduce: baloncesto, natación, ciclismo.

  2. ¿Play, go o do? karate, football, skating.

  3. Escribe los días del fin de semana.

  4. Completa: «I play the piano ___ Fridays.»

  5. Completa: «We go cycling ___ the weekend.»

  6. ¿Qué es un hobby?

  7. ¿Dónde se juega al tenis?

  8. ¿Qué dices al final de un partido?

  9. Contesta: «Do you play football?» (no)

  10. Escribe dos frases sobre tus aficiones con días.

Practica

  1. «Baloncesto» is…

    1. A) baseball
    2. B) basketball
    3. C) volleyball

  2. I ___ football.

    1. A) play
    2. B) go
    3. C) do

  3. I ___ swimming.

    1. A) play
    2. B) do
    3. C) go

  4. I ___ karate.

    1. A) play
    2. B) go
    3. C) do

  5. The weekend is…

    1. A) Saturday and Sunday
    2. B) Monday and Friday
    3. C) Friday and Monday

  6. I play tennis ___ Mondays.

    1. A) in
    2. B) on
    3. C) at

  7. A hobby is…

    1. A) an activity in your free time
    2. B) a school subject
    3. C) a sport place

  8. We swim in a…

    1. A) court
    2. B) pitch
    3. C) swimming pool

  9. «Good game!» is about…

    1. A) homework
    2. B) fair play
    3. C) food

  10. «What do you do in your free time?» — …

    1. A) Yes, I do.
    2. B) I play the guitar.
    3. C) On Monday.

Explícalo con tus palabras

Incluye: Cómo se llaman los deportes y las aficiones en inglés; Cuándo se usa play, go y do; Cómo digo qué días hago cada actividad; Qué es el fair play y qué frases uso.

Resumen

Tarjetas de repaso

Recórtalas: pregunta delante, respuesta detrás.

play + ball sportsplay football, play tennis.
go + -inggo swimming, go skating.
do + martial artsdo karate, do judo.
hobbyAfición: reading, drawing…
free timeTiempo libre.
on MondaysLos lunes (on + día).
at the weekendEl fin de semana.
fair playJuego limpio: Good game!

Soluciones

  1. B) Basketball.
  2. A) Pelota: play.
  3. C) -ing: go.
  4. C) Do karate.
  5. A) Sábado y domingo.
  6. B) On + día.
  7. A) Afición.
  8. C) Piscina.
  9. B) Juego limpio.
  10. B) Actividad.

Soluciones de los ejercicios

  1. basketball, swimming, cycling.
  2. do karate, play football, go skating.
  3. Saturday and Sunday.
  4. on.
  5. at.
  6. Una actividad que haces en tu tiempo libre porque te gusta.
  7. On a tennis court.
  8. Good game! / Well done!
  9. No, I don't.
  10. Model answer: I go swimming on Tuesdays. I play video games at the weekend.
